'''Aula Silvana''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living during the [[Eternal Empire conquest]]. By [[3630 BBY]] she was wanted by the [[Eternal Empire]] for smuggling, slander, grand theft and treason. She was last seen in [[Zakuul]] lower city and her wanted poster was displayed in the [[Overwatch]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Aula Silvana appears during '''Chapter 10: Anarchy in Paradise''' of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' on a wanted holo-poster.
